q1_issues.issue: (Agent sk_starts_1 glasnow) asserts Glasnow made the two starts, which the text never states — the adjunct NP "two starts with West Virginia" names no agent, and an event-noun serving only as a temporal anchor is supposed to get its class atom and the ordering relation and nothing else.
"with West Virginia" is a club affiliation, not an animate co-participant, so CoAgent over-commits the team to being a second doer of the starts.

q2_gaps: a temporal anchor that is a counted plural of event-nouns ("after two starts") — Before is defined over event witnesses, and no rule covers ordering a group of events against an event
"with <team/organization>" in the playing-for / affiliated-with sense — neither CoAgent (an animate co-doer) nor Instrument (a means) nor any where/when/how oblique fits it
notes: Both flagged role atoms also attach to the group symbol sk_starts_1 rather than to an event witness, which roles are defined over. The matrix clause itself (return event, Agent, Goal for "to Altoona", Past, both Name atoms) and the Before argument order for "after" are correct.
